xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialR: 1.The figures for the quarter ended December 31, 2024 are balancing figure between the audited figures for the year ended December 31, 2024 and the audited year to date figures for the nine months ended September 30, 2024. The figures for the quarter ended December 31, 2023 are the balancing figures between the audited figures for the year ended December 31, 2023 and the audited year to date figures for the nine months ended September 30, 2023. 2.These results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and have been approved for issue by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on March 06, 2025. The statutory auditors have expressed an unmodified audit opinion on these results. 3.The Company has completed an Initial Public Offer ( IPO ) of 123,720,440 equity shares of face value of Re. 1 each aggregating to Rs 87,500 Mn as an offer for sale by selling shareholder. The equity shares of the Company were listed on National Stock Exchange of India Limited ( NSE ) and BSE Limited ( BSE ) from February 19, 2025. 4.On May 3, 2024, the Group acquired 100% ownership interest of Softcrylic Technology Solutions India Pvt. Ltd (India) and Softcrylic LLC (USA) along with it's group company Softcrylic Inc. (Canada) for a purchase consideration of Rs. 12,314 Mn which includes initial upfront cash consideration and contingent consideration. Softcrylic is a premier data consulting firm headquartered in USA. Softcrylic has expertise in customer journeys and marketing technology and it would enable the Group to extend and customize the data journey beyond marketing into multiple lines of business. Considering the aforesaid business combination, the financial results for the year ended December 31, 2024 are not comparable with that of the previous periods. 5. During the year ended December 31, 2024, (a) Hexaware Technologies LLC (Russia) was liquidated w.e.f February 21, 2024 and gain of Rs. 22 Mn was transferred from FCTR to Profit & Loss. (b) Hexaware Technologies SL (Private) Limited (Sri Lanka) was incorporated w.e.f February 28, 2024. (c) Hexaware Novelty Technologies Ltd (UAE) (70% ownership) was incorporated w.e.f August 13, 2024. (d) Hexaware Nevada, Inc (USA) was incorporated w.e.f September 11, 2024. (e) Hexaware Information Technologies SDN. BHD.(Malaysia) was incorporated w.e.f December 13, 2024. 6.Other income includes Gain/(loss) due to Exchange rate difference of Rs 127 Mn and Rs 190 Mn for the quarter and year ended December 2024 respectively. 7.Employee Benefits expense includes Employee stock option compensation cost of Rs 111 Mn and Rs 353 Mn for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2024 respectively. 8.Employee Benefits expense includes Non-recurring Employee benefit and severance costs of Nil and Rs 465 Mn and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Transformation cost of Rs 125 Mn and Rs 462 Mn for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2024 respectively. 9.Other expenses includes Specific provisions for customers and onerous vendor contracts of Nil and Rs 96 Mn, Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Transformation cost of Rs 98 Mn and Rs 384 Mn, Acquisition related costs of Rs 15 Mn and Rs 334 Mn, IPO Related Costs of NIL and Rs 9 Mn and Regulatory Fees paid of NIL and Rs 170 Mn for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2024 respectively. 10.Depreciation and amortisation expense includes amortisation of intangible assets acquired in business combination of Rs 223 Mn and Rs 743 Mn for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2024 respectively. For other notes, refer results submitted as part of Integral filing/Outcome of the meeting.
